summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to a securities purchase agreement with Sarborg Limited and issuance of a senior secured convertible promissory note. The company will pay $8,000,000 for a 20% equity interest in Sarborg, partially through 650,000 shares of common stock issued at the August 28, 2026 price, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation, and cash from its ATM program with $150,000 minimum monthly payments due by May 31, 2027. The note to J.J. Astor Co. is for $541,620. No special-situation category applies; this is a financing arrangement.
